messages:
emily: Quick sync: spotted a token undercount affecting invoices from 2026-04-09 01:00-04:00 UTC. Posting immediate action list.
raj: Got it. I'll run a scoped ledger diff and produce a ranked customer deficit CSV.
tom: I'll own the controlled reprocess path and dry-run. Plan: dry-run -> verify no duplicates -> apply with rate limit.
refund-bot: Alert: ledger.raw_vs_applied_ratio = 0.987 for window 2026-04-09T01:00:00Z - 2026-04-09T04:00:00Z.
emily: Root cause (working hypothesis): batch-consumer pod restarted during compaction; late chunks collided with dedupe tombstones -> some events never reached ledger.
raj: SQL to find affected accounts (adjust window):
```
SELECT c.id AS customer_id, SUM(r.tokens) - COALESCE(SUM(l.tokens),0) AS missing_tokens
FROM raw_events r
LEFT JOIN ledger_events l ON r.event_id = l.event_id
JOIN customers c ON r.customer_id = c.id
WHERE r.event_ts >= '2026-04-09T01:00:00Z' AND r.event_ts < '2026-04-09T04:00:00Z'
GROUP BY c.id
HAVING missing_tokens > 0
ORDER BY missing_tokens DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
tom: Reprocess notes: use --idempotency-key=pm-mtr-1745558888; dry-run by 18:00 PT, apply (if clean) at 02:00 PT next day with --max-rate 5000evt/s.
emily: Ops mitigation: infra scaled node pool and increased pod memory temporarily. infra-bot: node autoscaler event at 2026-04-09T02:12:13Z correlated.
raj: I'll produce deficit CSV and split into tiers for comms: Tier 1 (> $8k impact), Tier 2 ($1k-$8k), Tier 3 (< $1k).
tom: Will ensure reprocess checks event_id dedup and original ordering where necessary. Dry-run will output a delta CSV for validation.
emily: Owners & ETAs (reply 'owned'):
1) Dry-run + delta report -> tom -> ETA 2026-04-09T18:00:00Z
2) Apply backfill (if clean) -> tom -> ETA 2026-04-10T02:00:00Z
3) Customer comms + credit template -> raj -> ETA 2026-04-10T09:00:00Z
4) Add reconcile alerts + dashboard -> emily/kevin -> ETA 2026-04-12
5) Runbook updates (replay + abort) -> oliver -> ETA 2026-04-13 EOD
tom: owned | dry-run scheduled; will paste CSV when ready.
raj: owned | drafting comms; will link to doc after I see CSV.
emily: owned | will coordinate dashboard + postmortem writeup.
ops-bot: Ticket FIN-3402 created for backfill; will auto-close when status=done.
emily: Decision: hold mass invoice reissues until ledger reconciled. For urgent enterprise customers we'll do manual credit memos.
infra-bot: Temporary mitigation persisted; recommend permanent increase to batch-consumer memory and a tweak to dedupe window config.
emily: Follow-ups: add weekly reconciliation job, add 'dedupe.discard_rate' metric, and include this incident tag 'postmortem/metering-1745558888' in all GH issues. Closing thread; will update with PR/memo links.
